subject: SIG questionnaire: control crosswalk and evidence consolidation plan
messages:
From: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@statera.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire — initial control mapping ask

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the fast turnaround on the RFP timeline. Our procurement and security teams started the SIG questionnaire and we hit a couple of places that need clarification before we proceed to evidence collection. High level asks:

- Can you provide a control crosswalk that maps Redwood product features / deployment modes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) to SIG control IDs? We want to map ownership and whether evidence is tenant-specific.
- Do you have a packaged evidence index (preferred: ZIP) for SOC 2 / ISO mappings — e.g., sample config screenshots, runbooks, and redwood-managed telemetry samples?
- For Private deployments: what exact artifacts demonstrate separation of customer data (KMS proofs, network diagrams, and HSM attestations)?

We are aiming to get the security team their initial packet by EOD Thursday our time (PST). Could you let me know who on your side will own the crosswalk and whether you can provide a draft by Wednesday?

Appreciate it — I can loop in Liam (procurement) if helpful.

Thanks,
Ava Morgan
Lead Security Analyst, Statera Systems
ava.morgan@statera.com

--
Attachment: statera_SIG_template_v1.xlsx (they attached the SIG baseline they filled out)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@statera.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — initial control mapping ask

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear summary and the template.

Kimberly (security program lead) will own the control crosswalk and evidence packaging; Aditya will coordinate the artifact bundle and the drive link. We can provide a draft control crosswalk that shows: product feature -> SIG ID -> control owner (product/infra/ops) -> evidence type (screenshot/runbook/log sample) by Wednesday EOD PST.

Quick clarifications so we align the deliverable:
- For Hosted and Dedicated we will indicate which artifacts are tenant-specific versus Redwood-managed. Hosted: most telemetry/log samples will be redacted; Dedicated: we can supply instance-level configuration artifacts depending on the contract.
- For Private (VPC/on-prem), we will include KMS key provenance notes and a diagram of network segmentation. HSM proofs: for on-prem customers we can provide attestation templates; for cloud-hosted Private we point to supported KMS integrations (Cloud KMS, AWS KMS) and provide sample key rotation logs.

Deliverables we will share Wednesday:
1) Control crosswalk (XLSX) mapped to your template
2) Evidence index (ZIP) with sampled screenshots, a short runbook excerpt, sample anonymized logs, and a brief memo on redaction approach
3) One-page summary that calls out any evidence gaps and recommended mitigations

We will send the drive link when ready. Any specific export format you prefer other than the ZIP + XLSX?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

--
Note: internal owners referenced: Kimberly Park (Security Program Lead), Aditya Rao (Compliance Ops)

From: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@statera.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarli <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Boyd <liam.boyd@statera.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — initial control mapping ask

Thanks Vivek — that plan sounds good. A couple of follow-ups from the security team after the kickoff:

> On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Quick clarifications so we align the deliverable:
>
> For Hosted and Dedicated we will indicate which artifacts are tenant-specific versus Redwood-managed. Hosted: most telemetry/log samples will be redacted; Dedicated: we can supply instance-level configuration artifacts depending on the contract.

1) For Hosted redaction: will you provide a sanitized sample of an audit log that includes column names and event types (no PII) so our SOC team can validate retention/retention windows?
2) For Dedicated: do you have a standard template for the customer-side configuration checklist we can use during procurement to ensure prerequisites are captured?
3) Private deployments: can the KMS key provenance memo include a sample CloudKMS export and a brief note on HSM proof expectations (what Redwood provides vs what the customer must provide)?

We are also sensitive to timeline: procurement would prefer the control crosswalk + a light evidence packet (PDF summary + 5 sample artifacts) by end of day Wednesday PST so legal can start redline review. Can Kimberly and Aditya try for an expedited minimal packet and then follow with the full ZIP?

If you can confirm we will plan to include your packet in an internal security review on Thursday.

Best,
Ava

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@statera.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — initial control mapping ask

Hi Ava — thanks for the fast-follow. We can do an expedited packet today with the minimal requested artifacts and then publish the full crosswalk + ZIP tomorrow morning. Quick summary of what we are attaching and where to find everything:

- Attached to this email: 
  - redwood_sig-control-summary.pdf (one-page executive summary mapping Hosted/Dedicated/Private ownership)
  - statera_SIG_control_crosswalk.xlsx (control crosswalk populated into your template)
  - statera_evidence_index_v1.zip (light packet: 5 artifacts — audit-log-sample.txt, config-checklist-dedicated.pdf, kms-provenance-memo.pdf, runbook-excerpt.pdf, telemetry-schema.json)

- Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/statera-sig-packet

Notes:
- Audit logs: we provided a sanitized audit-log-sample.txt (columns and event types only; no PII). Retention notes are in the kms-provenance-memo.pdf and the runbook excerpt.
- Dedicated config checklist: config-checklist-dedicated.pdf is a customer-side pre-provisioning checklist that legal/procurement can attach to the SOW.
- Private KMS: kms-provenance-memo.pdf includes a CloudKMS sample export snippet and a section called "HSM attestations" that explains which artifacts Redwood can supply (rotation logs, key IDs, access policy snapshots) and what we ask customers to provide for on-prem HSMs (hardware attestation and local KMS exports).

Next steps: please confirm receipt and we will follow up with the full evidence bundle (additional telemetry samples and expanded runbooks) tomorrow. If procurement/legal want an in-call walkthrough, we can book a 30-minute session with our compliance engineers.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Security Program Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: redwood_sig-control-summary.pdf, statera_SIG_control_crosswalk.xlsx, statera_evidence_index_v1.zip
